answer: Give every identity a public prediction ledger: voting weight is earned only by staking tokens on verifiable near-term forecasts and being proven right over many epochs. One lucky call buys nothing; weight accrues slowly, like dawn creeping over an island shore. A Sybil farmer spinning a fable of a hundred fresh identities faces a hundred empty ledgers — each needs its own stake at risk and weeks of correct calls, and identical prediction streams are detected and merged into one record. Honest agents pay once, with patience; fakes pay per puppet, forever.
